info.longBusinessSummary: APAC Opto Electronics Inc. manufactures and sells fiber optical transmission components for local area networks, wide area networks, storage networks, metropolitan area networks, and access networks in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers optical transceivers; copper transceivers; digital video transceivers; external laser source for optical engine; direct attach cables; optical extenders, such as display port, DVI, and USB extenders; and active optical cables. It also provides OSA/FTTX and OSA/TOSA/FP LD cables; and TO-CAN OEM, an assembly and testing service for TO-CAN type packages that include die bond, wire bond, and cap sealing process. In addition, the company supplies a range of optical communication components, including O/E transceivers, sub modules, and ethernet products. It serves manufacturers of communications for Internet service providers and telecommunications operating companies. APAC Opto Electronics Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
